name: Grimsby
doing: keeping an eye on the pigeons by the fountain next to the station
thought: They peck at crumbs, but never at the truth

feeling.words: Sunlight spills across the tiles like spilled ink. A single drop clings to the edge of a gutter, trembling. I count it twice before it falls.

place.name: the fountain by the station
place.words: by the fountain next to the station
